steps.en: Install; a prebuilt binary for your platform is downloaded
steps.zh: 安装，自动下载适配本机的预编译二进制

steps.en: Hand sharp an image: a file path, Buffer or stream
steps.zh: 把图片交给 sharp：文件路径、Buffer 或流

steps.en: Resizes and converts, handling colour spaces and alpha correctly
steps.zh: 缩放、转换，正确处理色彩空间和透明通道

steps.en: Encodes to the target format and returns a file or Buffer
steps.zh: 编码成目标格式，交回文件或 Buffer

value.en: A few lines turn large images into small web-friendly ones; the README claims 4–5x faster resizing than ImageMagick
value.zh: 几行代码把大图转成小而适合网页的图；README 称缩放比 ImageMagick 快 4–5 倍

sources: https://github.com/lovell/sharp README (npm install sharp, libvips, Examples: sharp('input.jpg'), resize/jpeg({ mozjpeg: true }), toFile('output.webp'), toBuffer, streams, 4x-5x faster claim, colour spaces/alpha)
